intent: Sum available-today units of the specific Dresselhaus machine screw (5mm/60mm) across every Graz store branch including those with zero availability, and cite each Graz store record plus the product record.

params.family_name: Dresselhaus Outdoor DRE 2A1-OSK Wood and Drywall Screw

success_criteria: Total = SUM(available_today_quantity) over ALL stores where city='Graz', counting stores with no/0 inventory as 0
refs contains the product record path and every Graz store record path

args.stdin:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand
    AND pv.model = :model
    AND pv.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM product_variant_properties WHERE property_key='screw_type' AND property_value_text = :screw_type)
    AND pv.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM product_variant_properties WHERE property_key='diameter_mm' AND property_value_number = :diameter_mm)
    AND pv.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM product_variant_properties WHERE property_key='length_mm' AND property_value_number = :length_mm)
)
SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path AS store_path, t.product_sku, t.product_path,
       COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS available_today
FROM target t
CROSS JOIN stores s
LEFT JOIN store_inventory si
  ON si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.product_sku = t.product_sku
WHERE s.city = :city
ORDER BY s.store_id;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand
    AND pv.model = :model
    AND pv.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM product_variant_properties WHERE property_key='screw_type' AND property_value_text = :screw_type)
    AND pv.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM product_variant_properties WHERE property_key='diameter_mm' AND property_value_number = :diameter_mm)
    AND pv.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM product_variant_properties WHERE property_key='length_mm' AND property_value_number = :length_mm)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity,0)),0) AS total_qty
FROM target t
CROSS JOIN stores s
LEFT JOIN store_inventory si
  ON si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.product_sku = t.product_sku
WHERE s.city = :city;
